suggestion: analyzed 6 comparable successful scheduled docs.yml parent runs from 2026-09-10T05:32:21Z to 2026-09-10T08:31:14Z plus their dispatched dashboard-build child runs. Parent workflow median execution was 88.5s (p90 106.5s) with dashboard/build/deploy job medians of 38s/31s/9s and zero queue time. Trusted child-run metadata confirmed cached activity reuse on all 6 samples because 'Dispatch activity refresh' was skipped every time, yet docs.yml still dispatches dashboard-build and waits for it on every schedule run. The parent dashboard job spends a 33s median (p90 36s) almost entirely in 'Dispatch dashboard build', while the child build job adds a 14s median (p90 20s). Current parent 'Restore dashboard from cache' then uses the child run-specific key and usually downloads the artifact instead of serving from a preexisting cache. With fresh activity already restored from cache in the child, this repeated workflow dispatch plus child rebuild path is avoidable for cache-mode schedule runs. Recommend first checking for the latest reusable dashboard artifact/cache in docs.yml and only dispatching dashboard-build when no fresh cached dashboard bundle is available or when mode=live. Expected savings are roughly 33s median at the parent step level and about 47s combined median across parent wait plus child build, exceeding the 15% median threshold but below 60s.
